connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

changeToken.description: Use the unchanged ChangeToken from the freshly fetched full record.

userContactType.description: Preserve the fetched value. Do not reset a user to Contact when an administrator has converted the record.

isEnabled.description: Preserve the fetched numeric value unless changing enabled status intentionally.

employer.description: RowUID from the Employer entity list.

position.description: RowUID from the Position entity list.

authProvider.description: Preserve the fetched authentication provider. API version 6 uses Password for password authentication.

roleAssignmentType.description: Preserve the fetched role assignment mode: DirectAssignment uses User Roles; SecurityGroups uses Security Groups.

userRoles[].description: Preserve the complete fetched direct-role assignments.

userRoles[].businessEntity.description: Role-scoped Business Entity. Preserve null for roles that apply across all entities.

securityGroups[].description: Preserve the complete fetched group assignments and parameters.

fileName.description: File name including its extension, such as document.pdf.

fileBytesBase64.description: The file contents encoded as Base64, a text representation of the file's bytes.

contentType.description: Optional media type, such as application/pdf. Inferred from the file name extension when omitted.

rowUid.description: Optional and not recommended for normal uploads. Supply only when migrating identical attachments between sandbox and production; otherwise let EHS Insight generate the identifier.
